metadata.what: Kodak High Definition 200: the same emulsion as KODAK PROFESSIONAL SUPRA 200.
metadata.data: None of its own. KODAK High Definition 200 Film (E-7017) publishes the same spectral sensitivity, characteristic and midscale/D-min curves as SUPRA 200 (E-4029, p. 7): digitised from each sheet they agree to within 0.0001. The engine loads kodak_supra_200 and overrides only the name.
